explanation: It is always 10 at D2. At GO it mostly tracks the choice: about 9 for a2 (10 if the previous trial was unrewarded), about 0 for a1 after a reward and 1-2 for a1 after no reward, but 4-6 when the agent has just switched from a2 to a1; at D1 it is about 5 while the agent is on an a2 streak (about 7 right after an unrewarded rare trial, falling to 0-2 after two or more unrewarded a2 trials in a row), and 0-2 while it is choosing a1.
